news.title: 1st Test, day two: Phillips out for 118, NZ 317/6 at lunch; Nicholls 146* after 8.5 hours
news.note: From 70/5 to 317/6: a 216-run stand (Nicholls-Phillips) ended by Akash Deep (2/45 off 21 at lunch). Bumrah wicketless on day two; AP says the green tinge has faded. Day two was still in play at our check (06:30 IST), so the Replay Room needs the stumps score.

news.title: Day one recap: Bumrah strikes third ball of the match on return, three wickets on day one; Nicholls' 12th Test hundred (fifth at the Basin)
news.note: Nicholls' Basin Reserve record is a ready-made data angle; India's four-seam plan worked for one session only.

news.title: Day two session timings: play 3:30-10:30 am IST
news.note: Day-after uploads should land by noon IST, after stumps.

news.title: England win the ODI series in Australia 2-1: Duckett 133, Sonny Baker 4/45, won by 97 runs in Hobart (18 Nov)
news.note: Global-audience angle; five T20Is follow from 21 Nov (MCG). Corrects our fixtures entry (result was unconfirmed yesterday).

news.title: India's next ODIs: Sri Lanka at Visakhapatnam 13 Dec, Bengaluru 16 Dec, Ahmedabad 19 Dec (2 pm IST); Zimbabwe ODIs 3-9 Jan 2027
MI captaincy: still only reports (Rohit 'set to' return, 31 Oct, unnamed sources); no official MI announcement found today
news.note: Keep the prepared 'Mumbai cha Raja' cut on Hold until MI confirm.
